components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+()0-9 ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Shares household

            already has the same last name and address (an intentionally shared household).

          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:

      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters
                of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the
                owners already in that city) assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who intentionally share a household
                (same last name and address, created with sharesHousehold=true). Present
                only for owners that belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-9F86D081884C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation: starts at 1,
                +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3.
                (Level 4 is reserved for tenure.)
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same business day (counted by registrationDate); otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed

              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-

                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+()0-9 ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (an intentionally shared household).
            When absent or false, such a request is rejected with 409. Write-only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters
                of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the
                owners already in that city) assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who intentionally share a household
                (same last name and address, created with sharesHousehold=true). Present
                only for owners that belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-9F86D081884C'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'. Two owners
                are duplicates only when their whole identityKey is equal; a create request
                whose identityKey matches an existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, assigned at creation: starts at 1,
                +1 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3.
                (Level 4 is reserved for tenure.)
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80 owners had already
                been created for the same business day (counted by registrationDate); otherwise
                false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD),
                or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## What I did

Consolidated the three separate duplicate checks (telephone, email, household) into a single derived `identityKey`.

**The key** — `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.util.OwnerIdentities.identityKey(owner)`:
```
normalizedTelephone + "|" + (email or empty) + "|" + (householdId or empty)
```
Each component is normalized identically for every owner (telephone → E.164 via the now-`public` `OwnerTelephone.toE164`, email trimmed/lower-cased, blank household/email → `""`), so comparison is stable and idempotent.

**The check** — new `CheckUniqueIdentity` function rejects with `DuplicateIdentityException` (409) only when a new owner's *whole* `identityKey` equals an existing owner's. It runs **after** `BuildOwner` and `AssignHousehold` in the `POST /api/owners` pipeline, so the new owner's `householdId` is already assigned and part of the key. Because telephone is in the key, two members of the same household with different telephones get different keys and are both allowed — exactly the behaviour change the spec requires.

**Returned** — added `identityKey` (readOnly) to the `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml`; the `OwnerMapper` populates it via `OwnerIdentities.identityKey(owner)`, so every owner response now carries it.

**Removed** — the three old check functions (`CheckUniqueTelephone/Household/Email`), their exceptions/handlers, and escalation YAMLs; added the new `DuplicateIdentityException` + handler + escalation YAML. Fixed dangling javadoc `{@link}`s and updated the now-inaccurate `sharesHousehold` description (it now only controls household joining, not the 409 gate).

The acceptance test `coreRejectsIdentityCollision` (two owners sharing a telephone, nothing else → same full key → 409) passes.
